headline: Turtacle ore weight
title: Turtacle | Cut Ore Weight Almost To Zero | Palworld Guide
video_script: Tired of being overweight from ore? Turtacle has a neat partner skill, Spikey Carrier. While it is in your party, the weight of ore drops by eighty to one hundred percent. It also has Watering level two, Mining level one and Transporting level one. Perfect for long mining trips in Palworld one point zero. Do you carry Turtacle? Comment below!
description: Turtacle in Palworld 1.0 cuts ore weight by eighty to one hundred percent while it is in your party.
